verdict.rationale: ROS 2's own rosbag tooling records robot data (`ros2 bag` record/play). The docs say it provides a Python API for reading from and writing to a bag, so collected data can be pulled programmatically for offline analysis. Community users confirm data bagging is a valued built-in feature. However, the evidence shows no SQL interface, no query or filtering capability over recorded data, and no export to analysis formats, so only the 'read via API' half of the story is supported. Missing for 10: SQL or query interface over collected data, documented export to external formats (e.g., CSV/Parquet), filtering or time-range querying of bags, hands-on corroboration of the bag-reading API for analysis workflows.
